temperature_matching_rule: DEFAULT, no rescaling: the rigid modes are read as projected and KEPT, because the fine box's intermolecular bath is what a rigid replacement inherits and its 3N temperature averages that bath with vibrations that have not equilibrated (runs 2 and 3: rescaling to the 3N reading relaxed back within one readout with energy conserved). --match-3n rescales to the 3N reading and records the kinetic energy removed, which is NOT part of the arm's energy ledger
